rules.question: What words and figure does the Path Builder show for a squeeze?
rules.owner: app::activation_badges in src/app/path_view.cpp, the Paths tab's badge words, which the builder reads only through badges_text in src/pathbuilder/pb_text.cpp
rules.decision: D302 item 3: every squeeze the builder names uses the Paths tab's badge words; the user, on seeing the builder's own squeeze wording again: "why do you keep inventing your own text instead of using what already exists?"; task B5 of the plan.
must_match: inline constexpr const char* kNoTimingNeededText = "no timing needed";
"Squeeze-out: a Star Power phrase ends right where your Star Power runs out; hitting "
must_not_match: return "This window can't end with the squeeze-out it was pinned to.";

owner_lines.why: tight_window_note: the violet Path limit note names the figure the limit is checked against, not a squeeze's words; the plan's Q1 kept the note as it was

rules.note: The builder kept writing its own squeeze wording ("squeeze-in, no timing", "no timing needed", a glossary) beside the Paths tab's badges, so the two screens said different things. Every squeeze and early fill the builder names now comes from the badges through badges_text, which reads activation_badges and so is not flagged. The row flags a builder string that words a squeeze, an early fill or a missing timing itself, and a read of the activation's timing figures, which only the badges should turn into text. impossible_window_text's failure sentence about the squeeze-out a window was pinned to names the player's pinned choice, not a timing or a figure, so the pattern leaves it alone. A scope names a top folder or a single file (OwnerRule::scope), so the row lists each file under src/pathbuilder; a new file there joins the list.
